english: Let $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$ be defined by $f(x)=x^3-11x$. For $t\in[-3,0]$, let $D(t)$ denote the mean deviation about the mean of the four observations $t,\ -t,\ f(t),\ f(-t)$. Then the value of $t\in[-3,0]$ at which $D(t)$ attains its maximum value is ______.
hindi: माना $f:\mathbb{R}\to\mathbb{R}$, $f(x)=x^3-11x$ द्वारा परिभाषित है। $t\in[-3,0]$ के लिए माना $D(t)$ चार प्रेक्षणों $t,\ -t,\ f(t),\ f(-t)$ का माध्य के सापेक्ष माध्य विचलन है। तब $t\in[-3,0]$ का वह मान जिस पर $D(t)$ अपना अधिकतम मान प्राप्त करता है, ______ है।
solution: $f$ is odd, so $f(-t)=-f(t)$; the four observations sum to $0$, mean $0$
Ends: $D(-3)=4.5$, $D(0)=0$, so the maximum is at $t=-2$
solution_full: $f(-x)=-x^3+11x=-f(x)$, so $f(-t)=-f(t)$ and the observations are $t,-t,f(t),-f(t)$, with sum $0$ and mean $0$.
$D'(t)=\dfrac{3t^2-12}{2}$, which is zero at $t=-2$ in $[-3,0]$. $D'$ is positive on $(-3,-2)$ and negative on $(-2,0)$ (first derivative test); also $D''(t)=3t$, $D''(-2)=-6<0$.
So the maximum of $D$ on $[-3,0]$ is $8$, attained at $t=-2$.
originality_note: New: a data set built from an odd function has mean 0 for every t, so its mean deviation is (|t| + |f(t)|)/2, a smooth cubic on the interval once the signs are fixed, maximised by the derivative tests (way 2: a statistic of a moving family, then optimised). Closest known: maxima of a cubic on an interval. Different because: the cubic appears only after the statistic is simplified and the absolute values are resolved on the interval.
stem_review: Read as a student: every observation, class, symbol and condition is introduced before use, each sentence has one reading; the answer was recomputed independently in Python (exact fractions / sympy), is unique and equals the Answer Plan. Checked numerically on a fine grid that the maximum is at t = -2. Changed: No change.
key_step: Noticing the mean is always 0 and resolving the absolute values on [-3,0] to get a cubic.
justification: Two ideas linked (statistic of a family, derivative tests with end points) in numerical format. Comparable to the L3 calculus-in-context anchor 2026-P1-Q1 (L3).

concept_use.Mean deviation about the mean: Mean 0 for all t gives D(t) = (|t| + |f(t)|)/2 = (t^3 - 12t)/2 on [-3,0].
concept_use.Maxima & Minima: First & Second Derivati: D'(t) = 0 at t = -2 with D'' < 0 and the end-point comparison.
